name: Creekside Lateral (Kinder Morgan)
researcher_notes: Kinder Morgan's first quarter 2026 earnings release, dated April 22, 2026, says the company is advancing the Creekside Lateral, about 11.2 miles of 42-inch pipe in Central Texas. The cost is about 85 million dollars. It is designed to serve power generation, industrial and data center demand and is backed by binding long-term contracts. In service is targeted for the fourth quarter of 2026. No existing GEM row matches. The August 2026 EIA workbook does not list it. This is the only source found, so the tier is medium. Two more searches found no second source, no endpoints, no county, no Texas Railroad Commission filing and no named data center. Start and end locations, the owning Kinder Morgan company and the exact status are not stated, so they are left blank. Status is proposed because the release says only that development is advancing. It may already be under construction. DataCenter is left blank. The release lists data centers as one of three kinds of demand, beside power plants and industry, and names no campus or customer. The Transwestern Desert Southwest Expansion was left blank for the same reason. Intrastate line, so no FERC filing is expected. Route not found. Next step: check the Texas Railroad Commission T-4 permit search for a Kinder Morgan Creekside filing.
